# tinyparse (stand-in)

A synthetic fixture for the `count-lines-local` eval task: four small generated files under `src/` that total exactly
1,318 lines (`wc -l src/*.js`), which `check/__eval__.test.js` expects. It is original to this repository, licensed
like it (Apache-2.0), and not a copy of any upstream library. The task only counts lines; the code is never run.
